title: The cross-border seller
subtitle: A Delaware entity with operations elsewhere
prompt: I live in Brazil and sell home accessories. I want a Delaware LLC for Amazon US and my own online store. A logistics partner will hold my inventory in California. Amazon collects sales tax, so I assume I only need to register in Delaware?
provided: Physical goods sold through Amazon and a direct store
Assumes marketplace tax collection covers all obligations
missing: Owners, tax status, and intended federal classification
All storage locations and direct sales by state
US employees, agents, and importer arrangements
Brazilian entity ownership and tax treatment

questions.question: Who owns the goods while stored, and in which states can the logistics partner place them?
questions.why: Inventory location is relevant to a state-by-state nexus review.

questions.question: What sales go through a collecting marketplace versus your direct store, and where are customers located?
questions.why: Marketplace treatment cannot simply be extended to direct sales.

questions.question: Who will own the LLC, and will you make any tax classification election?
questions.why: Identify the federal classification before assessing returns.

questions.question: Which entity buys the goods, imports them, contracts with the warehouse, and receives sales proceeds?
questions.why: Collect transaction and operating facts for tax and import specialists.

questions.question: Will you or a related Brazilian company fund or supply the US entity?
questions.why: Identify related-party flows that need reporting and pricing analysis.

concerns.title: California deserves its own review
concerns.detail: California inventory and direct sales make registration and sales-tax review relevant. Marketplace facilitator rules must be checked against each sales channel.

concerns.title: State and federal analyses differ
concerns.detail: Default LLC classification establishes a starting point for federal analysis, not a resolution of state obligations.

concerns.title: Foreign owner transactions
concerns.detail: Owner or related-company flows may require Form 5472 analysis depending on classification and ownership.

specialists.role: US state and local tax adviser
specialists.decision: Assess registrations, marketplace exceptions, direct-sale collection, and other state taxes separately.
specialists.needs: Inventory reports, fulfillment contract and sales by state/channel

specialists.decision: Assess federal business exposure, related-party flows, import responsibilities, and Brazilian treatment.
specialists.needs: Supply contracts, importer details, ownership and operating facts

takeaway: Delaware formation does not contain the business's footprint to Delaware.
